fields.label: Worker
fields.description: The worker being paid. Approved unpaid earnings must exist for this worker and project.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: Allocate the payment against this job, so project wage balances remain accurate.

fields.label: Submitted ERPNext Payment
fields.description: Select a submitted employee Payment Entry for this worker and project. The full payment is allocated once; this record does not send money.

fields.label: Paid Amount
fields.description: Copied from the submitted payment. Submit this settlement to record wages paid against approved earnings.

fields.label: Payment reference
fields.description: Optional bank, cash or transfer reference. Add it later without changing the confirmed amount.
